title.narrative: RLF - Moldovan Railways Crisis Response &amp;#128;23m loan

description.narrative: The original operation was to finance only the acquisition of materials required for the rehabilitation of the railway infrastructure on Moldova's Valcinets - Balti - Ungheni section (Tranche I) and the Chisinau - Cainari section (Tranche II). Following the approval of the loan increase (Moldovan Railways Crisis Response - Loan Increase, OpID 55285 which forms an integral part of the Project), the Project scope was updated and now includes the railway infrastructure rehabilitation (all components) of the entire North-Central section (Valcinets - Balti - Ungheni - Chisinau - Cainari section) of the North-South Rail Corridor (the "Project"). This is an update of the PSD originally published on 15 March 2023. The Project will support Moldova's economic development, increase its logistics and transit potential and bring operational efficiency from improved regional infrastructure through the rehabilitation of the railway sections on the North-South Rail Corridor. The Project will facilitate the transportation of goods via alternative routes from Ukraine via Moldova to the EU. This aims to ensure food security and improves the access for Ukrainian goods to the largest operable port at the Black Sea, Constanta, as well as to ports in Romania, Moldova and Ukraine - at Galati, Reni, Ismail and Giurgiulesti, with a cumulative operating capacity that can absorb a significant part of Ukraine's export needs. The Project supports the shift from high to low-carbon modes of transport as the goods from and to Ukraine via Moldova are predominantly transported by road due to the lack of capacity of the Moldovan North-Central railway network. The Project is expected to increase the throughput capacity and lift speed restrictions on the current rail infrastructure.
